pages.text: The Chishi Energy Aggregator condenses vast amounts of Chi Energy into Chishi Ingots, the origin of Chishi equipment:$(br2)$(li)Consumes 10M Chi Energy$(li)1 Netherite Ingot input$(li)1 Chishi Ingot output$(br2)$(bold)Geode Upgrading$(): feed in a geode block and spend 10M Chi Energy to raise it to the next tier (Flawed → Normal → Pristine → Perfect), boosting geode production.$(br2)Holds up to 200M energy, can be fed by pipes, and exposes a vanilla container for logistics automation.
